parsed.note_claim: The central Tower of Jesus Christ was finished in 2026, but the Sagrada Família is not fully complete.
parsed.label: SUPPORTS
parsed.quote: In 2026, the tallest tower of the Basilica, at 172.5 meters, will be completed. A key step that brings us closer to the final stage of the Temple's construction.
parsed.reason: The page confirms the 2026 tower completion and states this brings them closer to the final stage, implying the basilica is not fully complete.
